contentList.content: Marksmen are trained fighters who excel in delivering heavy ranged damage. Level 3 - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Marksman_Pointblank">Marksman Training</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Marksman_BonusDamage">Steady Aim</LSTag> Level 7 - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="TremendousStrength">Tremendous Strength</LSTag> Level 9 - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="HeavyShot">Heavy Shot</LSTag>
Ranged attacks can push target back for 3 meters
Increases damage roll and attack roll with ranged weapons by 1.
Ranged attacks have chance to inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED">Off Balance</LSTag>.
When you make ranged attacks within melee range, the <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> do not have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
